article.title: 更進新聞：GS1香港峰會落幕，聚焦產品數碼身分與跨境對接
article.title_en: Follow-up: GS1 Hong Kong summit concludes with product identity and buyer connections
article.summary: 11月6日活動新增落幕及買家對接消息，產品資料可信度成品牌實務重點。
article.summary_en: The November 6 event adds summit and buyer-connection developments, with trusted product data as a practical brand priority.
highlights: 內地品牌與跨境電商、香港零售商進行現場對接。
GS1以成分、產地及認證資料說明產品數碼身分用途。
highlights_en: Mainland brands met cross-border platforms and Hong Kong retailers.
GS1 used ingredients, origin and certifications to explain product digital identity.
article.why: 品牌內容、商品主檔與可追溯資料若能對齊，較容易支援跨渠道產品介紹及買家查詢。
article.why_en: Aligned brand content, product records and traceability data can support channel presentations and buyer questions.
article.next_step: 挑一個SKU核對商品編碼、成分、產地及認證連結，確認各渠道引用同一資料。
article.next_step_en: Audit one SKU’s identifier, ingredients, origin and certification links across channels.
article.detail: 這篇跟進11月6日實際舉行的峰會及買家對接，沒有重刊上一期已報道的KPMG與GS1調查數字。GS1提出以既有Digital Link標準連結可信產品資料，並非當天發布新的二維碼標準。主辦方對AI推薦與信任的看法屬其論述，未構成銷售增長或搜尋排名的證據。品牌可先完成單一商品資料盤點，再評估如何讓零售商及消費者讀取。
article.detail_en: This follows the actual summit and buyer session, without repeating yesterday’s survey figures. Digital Link is an existing standard. The organiser’s views on AI recommendations are not evidence of sales lift or search ranking. Begin with a single-product data audit.
article.source: GS1 Hong Kong / PR Newswire APAC
article.section: 行業影響 & 品牌案例
